sloka: रामस्य व्यवसायज्ञा लक्ष्मणस्य च धीमतः ।न अत्यर्थम् क्षुभ्यते देवी गन्गा इव जलद आगमे ॥५-१६-४॥
transliteration: rāmasya vyavasāyajñā lakṣmaṇasya ca dhīmataḥ ।na atyartham kṣubhyate devī gangā iva jalada āgame ॥5-16-4॥

translations.english: "Just as river Ganga is not agitated by the rainbearing clouds, this Sita is not perturbed as she is aware of the prowess of Rama and might of Lakshmana.
